name: google-docs-style
description: Google developer documentation style for Codex plans and docs. Bundles a skill, formatter, and lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Google developer documentation style for plans and docs
interface.longDescription: Write plans, design docs, READMEs, ADRs, and how-to guides in Google developer documentation style. Hooks inject the same rules on session start, prompt submit, and document writes. A formatter rewrites headings and flags voice issues.
defaultPrompt: Write this plan in Google developer documentation style.
Create a how-to guide using the Google docs style templates.
